text: dsh-restart-client 是面向 DSH 桌面环境的重启插件，在界面标题栏角落提供重启按钮，并在宿主端注册 HTTP 状态与重启路由以及 restart_dsh_client agent 工具。它支持重启整个桌面应用或仅重启 Harness 服务；按钮发送客户端重启请求，工具和路由可选择模式、延迟或 dry run。适合需要从界面或自动化调用恢复 DSH 客户端的用户。完整桌面重启依赖 Windows 环境；未发现 API 密钥或外部服务配置。

dsh-restart-client adds a header-corner button, HTTP status and restart routes, and the restart_dsh_client agent tool. Restart the full desktop app or Harness service; choose a mode and delay, or inspect a dry run. Full desktop restart requires Windows; no API key or external service is configured.
想从 DSH 界面点一下就重启整个桌面客户端。
怎么让 agent 选择重启 DSH 客户端或只重启 Harness 服务？
I need an HTTP endpoint to check the DSH host status and request a restart.
dsh-restart-client 的功能「桌面一键重启」：在 DSH 标题栏角落显示按钮，点击后通过 POST 重启路由请求重启整个桌面应用；按钮提供忙碌和失败状态，并在超时后刷新页面。
dsh-restart-client 的功能「可控重启入口」：agent 工具和 HTTP 重启路由支持选择整个客户端或 Harness 服务模式，也可 dry run 查看计划；状态路由返回宿主进程信息。

dsh-restart-client README · dsh-restart-client：A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin that adds a **one-click restart** for the desktop client — a header-corner button, an HTTP endpoint, and an agent tool, all backed by the same host capability.

Click once. No confirmation dialog, no second press, no console window.

dsh-restart-client README · Why：The DSH desktop app ships restart only as an official **service-only** extension: it respawns the Harness process and leaves the window running, so host-side changes still need a manual quit-and-relaunch. This plugin restarts the **whole application** while keeping the experience to a single click.

dsh-restart-client README · What it does：| Entry point | Kind | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Restart button | Client slot `shell.overlay`, portaled into the host header corner (right of the native right-panel toggle) — never displaces it | One click → the desktop app restarts |
| `POST /api/dsh-restart/restart` | HTTP route | Same operation for scripts and other plugins |
| `GET /api/dsh-restart/status` | HTTP route | Reports the resolved desktop process and mode plan |
| `restart_dsh_client` | Agent tool | Lets the model restart the client itself |

dsh-restart-client README · What it does：Two modes:

- **`client`** (default) — kill the whole desktop process tree, wait for it to disappear, then relaunch the executable. The window really restarts.
- **`service`** — respawn only the Harness service process and exit, leaving the desktop alone.

dsh-restart-client README · As a regular DSH bundle：Because `package.json` points `exports` at the real files and the profile links the directory, editing `client.js` is picked up on the next page load; editing `index.js` (the host half) needs a real client restart.

dsh-restart-client README · One-click install (Windows)：`install-oneclick-restart.ps1` fetches the published package from the CDN, copies it into
`%APPDATA%\dsh-desktop\harness\profiles\web\node_modules\dsh-restart-client`, and appends the
`insert` entry to `cordis.patch.yml`. It verifies every file against a recorded Git blob SHA-1 and
backs up the patch file before touching it. Idempotent — safe to re-run.
dsh-restart-client README · How the no-console restart works：The interesting part, and the reason this plugin exists rather than a five-line shell wrapper.

dsh-restart-client README · How the no-console restart works：A helper process has to outlive the app it is about to kill, so it is created through WMI (`Win32_Process.Create`), which reparents it to `WmiPrvSE` and lets it survive `taskkill /T` on the desktop tree. But **WMI-created processes always get a console window**, and none of the usual tricks suppress it — `-WindowStyle Hidden` does not, and a `Win32_ProcessStartup` with `ShowWindow = 0` returns success while the console still appears (measured on Windows 10/11).

dsh-restart-client README · How the no-console restart works：So the helper is launched indirectly:

1. Write a tiny `.vbs` launcher (UTF-16LE **with BOM** — WSH accepts only ANSI or UTF-16, and temp paths may contain non-ASCII user names).
2. The launcher runs `shell.Run "<helper command>", 0, False` — window style `0` means no window at all.
3. WMI creates `wscript.exe //nologo <launcher.vbs>`, which starts the helper invisibly.

dsh-restart-client README · The button：It occupies **one** seat, but shows on every page. `apply()` registers a component into the root-level slot `shell.overlay`, which exists even on the sessionless welcome screen, so the component is always mounted. The component does not render the button itself — it tracks `[data-conversation-header-corner]` with a `MutationObserver` (the host corner appears late, e.g. on the welcome screen), creates a `<span data-dshc-mount>` and appends it as the corner's **last** child, then `react-dom` `createPortal` renders the button into it.

dsh-restart-client README · The button：Position is therefore decided entirely by host layout: the corner is pushed to the far right of the header row by the host's own `margin-left:auto`, and the plugin writes no `top`/`left` and keeps no fixed anchor. The corner is a single-occupant host slot already taken by the native right-panel toggle, so `ctx.slots` cannot register into it — which is why the plugin ports the button instead of registering a sibling.

dsh-restart-client README · The button：Styled as a ghost button in the shell's token language: 28px square, compact control radius, transparent until hover, `--dsw-alias-label-secondary` → `--dsw-alias-label-primary`, a gentle icon turn on hover, a spin while busy, and `--dsw-alias-state-error-primary` with a **Retry** face for six seconds if the request fails. It honors `prefers-reduced-motion`.

dsh-restart-client README · `POST /api/dsh-restart/restart`：```jsonc
{ "mode": "client", "delayMs": 1500, "dryRun": false }
```

`delayMs` is clamped to 120000 and defaults to 1500, giving the HTTP response time to reach the browser before the app dies.

Response:

```jsonc
{
  "ok": true,
  "mode": "client",
  "desktopPid": 12724,

Both routes reject untrusted origins (403) through `ctx.connection.requestRejection`, and reject the wrong method (405).

dsh-restart-client README · Agent tool `restart_dsh_client`：```jsonc
{ "mode": "client", "dryRun": true }
```

The current turn is interrupted by a real restart.

dsh-restart-client README · Layout：```
index.js            host half — routes, WMI/VBS launcher, agent tool
client.js           client half — the header-corner button
cordis.patch.yml    bundle patch: inserts the plugin entry
locale/zh.json      plugin marketplace metadata (Chinese)

`index.js` imports nothing but Node built-ins.

dsh-restart-client README · Limitations：- **Windows-centric.** The windowless launcher path is WSH-specific; other platforms fall back to the direct route.
- **Single instance.** The relaunch waits up to 20s for the old pid to disappear, because the app hands a second launch to the dying instance; if the pid outlives that, it relaunches anyway and logs it.
- **A restart interrupts the turn.** Any tool call in flight is killed with the process.
